briefdescription.para: Initialize the scheduler with a task array.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to an array of SYN_Task structs. Each task should already be initialized via syn_task_create().
Number of tasks in the array.

briefdescription.para: Configure the maximum starvation wait window for a priority level.

detaileddescription.para: Values below 1 are clamped to 1 ms because tick resolution is 1 ms.

parameterdescription.para: Maximum wait window in milliseconds (clamped to >= 1).

briefdescription.para: Attach or detach a task execution profiler on sched.

detaileddescription.para: When a non-NULL enabled profiler is attached, syn_sched_run() wraps every task dispatch with syn_task_profile_step_start() and syn_task_profile_step_end() using syn_port_get_tick_us(), recording peak cooperative chunk duration (max_yield_us) per task slot. Pass NULL to detach.

parameterdescription.para: Profiler manager to attach, or NULL to detach.

memberdef.argsstring: (SYN_Task *task, const char *name, SYN_TaskFunc func, SYN_Prio priority, void *user_data)
memberdef.name: syn_task_create

detaileddescription.para: Sets the task to READY state with the protothread reset to the top.

parameterdescription.para: Human-readable name (stored by pointer, not copied).
Optional pointer to task-private data (or NULL).

briefdescription.para: Query whether the running task should yield to share CPU time.

detaileddescription.para: Returns true when another eligible task has active work (PT_MORE) at equal or higher priority, or when any other eligible task has reached its starvation deadline. Returns false when called outside task's dispatch.

parameterdescription.para: Task descriptor of the currently running task.

simplesect.para: true if task should yield now, false otherwise.

detaileddescription.para: Selects and executes a single eligible task using ranked order (Overdue -> Work -> Poll -> Round reset), ordered by priority and per-priority round-robin within every rank.

simplesect.para: true if at least one task is still alive (not DEAD).

detaileddescription.para: Equivalent to while (1) { syn_sched_run(sched); }. This function never returns.

briefdescription.para: Suspend a task. It will be skipped by the scheduler until resumed.

simplesect.para: Main-loop / task context only (not intended for arbitrary ISR use).

briefdescription.para: Resume a suspended or condition-blocked task, making it eligible to run.

simplesect.para: ISR-safe. Calling this from an ISR or driver wakes tasks parked in PT_BLOCK_CONDITION (and wrapper macros) or syn_task_suspend(). Tasks actively waiting on PT_BLOCK_EVENT* remain blocked until their event flag or timeout fires.

briefdescription.para: Restart a task from the beginning of its protothread.

detaileddescription.para: Resets the protothread continuation, releases any held mutexes, restores base priority, and sets the task to READY.

briefdescription.para: Get the number of tasks that are still alive in the scheduler.
Temporarily boost a task's execution priority.

detaileddescription.para: Monotonically ratchets task->priority upward when temp_prio < task->priority (SYN_PRIO_CRITICAL = 0 is highest); calls with temp_prio >= task->priority are ignored so active higher boosts are never lowered. Promotes the task to Work rank and tightens due_ms to the boosted priority's starvation window when bound to a scheduler.

briefdescription.para: Restore a task's priority back to its configured base priority (preserving any active mutex priority-inheritance boost).
Dynamically set a task's base priority and recompute active priority.

detaileddescription.para: Preserves any higher active mutex boost, and promotes Work rank / tightens due_ms when raising effective priority.
